acceptanceCriteria: Age is computed from the first-parent commit on base that introduced the change.
Output records the base ref and its last-observed time (e.g. FETCH_HEAD mtime) so a stale base is visible.
body: Residual from V1-1710 (PR #1097). Age of the oldest missing shared commit is its committer time, so a commit authored long ago but merged recently looks stale immediately, and the command never fetches, so a stale origin/main understates what is missing. Both are recorded as failure modes in SPC-V0. Expected: age measured from arrival on the base (first-parent merge time), and output states the base ref observation time.
